mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_plan (user_id, week_start, day_of_week, meal_type, recipe_id, recipe_name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{weekStart}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{mealType}, #{recipeId}, #{recipeName})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM weekly_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND week_start = #{weekStart} ORDER BY day_of_week, meal_type
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM weekly_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND week_start = #{weekStart}
